author: ojiudezue
title: Overnight 11-28: perimeter gates disposed at their date (D5 keep, D3 parked); memory pick mooted by restart
summary: PERIMETER-FP-GATES-DISPOSE-1 hit its 11-28 dispose-by. One DB cross-tab of 1,312 perimeter_gate_decision rows: the single-source demote (D5) made 15 demotes in 14 days, all g5_bullet, none wrong, so it stays enforcing; the zone-agreement gate (D3) produced zero rows because perimeter_zone_sensors was never set, so it parks with setting that option as its revival trigger. The 8 s settle-wait PICK stays with Oji. HA-CORE-MEMORY-GROWTH-1's PICK A (read logs before restart) became moot when the 11-27 attended deploys restarted Core (3.9 GB free, swap 0.8 GB), so the card was re-baselined with a 12-01 slope check. No builds: review lane at the 3-card WIP cap. HA MCP down, so log-based checks were recorded as gaps, not all-clears.
why: Soak Exit: a dispose-by date is binary, not a reason to keep waiting. The card's own rule said D3 parks at no rows, and D5's evidence is small and clean. A pick whose precondition no longer holds must be rewritten, or the operator gets asked an impossible question.
alternatives_considered: Extend D3's window until the zone sensors are set (rejected: unbounded soak; parking with a trigger is the same outcome, made explicit)
Turn D5 off for low volume (rejected: it is targeted and has made no wrong demotes; volume is controlled by the zone config, not D5)
